text: The accounting equation is stated as:
subject: Financial Accounting
options: Assets = Liabilities + Capital|Assets + Capital = Liabilities|Capital = Assets + Liabilities|Assets = Capital - Liabilities
explanation: Assets equal the sum of outside claims (liabilities) and the owner's claims (capital).

text: Recording a transaction in the journal for the first time is called:
subject: Financial Accounting
options: Posting|Journalising|Ledgerising|Balancing off
explanation: The journal is the book of original entry.

text: When cash is received from a customer on account the entry is:
subject: Financial Accounting
options: Debit Cash and Credit Sales|Debit Sales and Credit Cash|Debit Cash and Credit the customer's account|Debit the customer's account and Credit Cash
explanation: Cash (asset) increases with a debit and the debtor's claim decreases with a credit.

text: Every transaction affects at least two accounts in equal amounts. This is the:
subject: Financial Accounting
explanation: This is the dual aspect concept of double entry book keeping.

text: State the dual aspect concept of accounting.
subject: Financial Accounting
correctAnswer: Every transaction has two equal and opposite effects so two entries (a debit and a credit) are recorded.

text: The ledger is called the book of:
subject: Financial Accounting
options: Original entry|Final entry|Subsidiary entry only|Cash entry
explanation: The journal records transactions first and the ledger (final entry) groups them by account.

text: The trial balance is prepared mainly to check the:
subject: Financial Accounting
options: Profitability of the business|Arithmetic accuracy of ledger posting|Solvency of the business|Efficiency of the staff
explanation: Equality of total debits and credits detects one sided and amount errors.

text: A cash account showing a credit balance in the trial balance indicates:
subject: Financial Accounting
options: A cash shortage|An overdrawn position|A credit sale|An arithmetical error only
explanation: When the bank pays more than the business deposits the cash book balance becomes negative.

text: The trial balance will NOT detect an error of omission. This statement is:
subject: Financial Accounting
explanation: When a transaction is completely left out both sides stay equal so the trial balance agrees.

text: List any four errors that are not disclosed by the trial balance.
subject: Financial Accounting
correctAnswer: Errors of omission; errors of commission; errors of principle; and compensating errors.

text: The statement that shows the profit earned from trading is the:
subject: Financial Accounting
options: Profit and Loss Account|Trading Account|Balance Sheet|Cash Flow Statement
explanation: The trading account computes gross profit from sales and cost of goods sold.

text: Gross profit is calculated as:
subject: Financial Accounting
options: Net sales minus all expenses|Net sales minus cost of goods sold|Revenue plus capital|Sales minus drawings
explanation: Cost of goods sold = opening stock + purchases + direct expenses - closing stock.

text: Closing stock is shown:
subject: Financial Accounting
options: Only in the Balance Sheet|Only in the Trading Account|On the credit side of the Trading Account and as current asset in the Balance Sheet|Only in the Profit and Loss Account
explanation: It is valued for the trading account and reported as a current asset.

text: A current liability such as a creditor is shown on the:
subject: Financial Accounting
options: Assets side of the Balance Sheet|Liabilities side of the Balance Sheet|Debit side of the Trading Account|Credit side of the P and L Account only
explanation: Liabilities and capital appear on the liabilities side of the balance sheet.

text: Distinguish between gross profit and net profit.
subject: Financial Accounting
correctAnswer: Gross profit is sales minus cost of goods sold; net profit is gross profit minus operating expenses plus non operating incomes.

text: A bank reconciliation statement is prepared to reconcile:
subject: Financial Accounting
options: The cash book balance with the pass book balance|The trial balance with the balance sheet|Sales with debtors|Assets with liabilities
explanation: It explains differences such as cheques not presented and bank charges not recorded.

text: A cheque deposited and recorded in the cash book but not yet cleared by the bank is in the BRS:
subject: Financial Accounting
options: Deducted from the pass book balance|Added to the pass book balance|Ignored completely|Debited in the pass book
explanation: The pass book has not yet received the credit so it is added to reach the cash book figure.

text: Depreciation is charged because of:
subject: Financial Accounting
options: Physical wear and tear only|Obsolescence only|The passage of time; wear and tear; and obsolescence|Capital loss only
explanation: The service potential of a fixed asset falls for all three reasons.

text: Under the straight line method the depreciation charge each year:
subject: Financial Accounting
correctAnswer: Is the same on the original cost
explanation: A fixed percentage of the original cost is charged until the asset is fully depreciated.

text: State any three methods of providing depreciation.
subject: Financial Accounting
correctAnswer: Straight line method; diminishing balance method; and units of production method.

text: A valid contract requires:
subject: Commercial Law
options: Offer and acceptance only|Free consent; lawful consideration; competent parties; and a lawful object|A written document only|Stamp paper only
explanation: All the essentials under the Indian Contract Act 1872 must be present together.

text: An agreement without consideration is generally:
subject: Commercial Law
options: Always valid|Void|Enforceable by the court|A quasi contract
explanation: Consideration is a price in legal terms and agreement without it is void except narrow exceptions.

text: Coercion in the Indian Contract Act means:
subject: Commercial Law
options: An expression of two or more meanings|Obtaining consent by unlawful pressure or threat|A casual promise|A written notice
explanation: Coercion vitiates free consent and makes the contract voidable.

text: A contract may come to an end by performance; mutual agreement; or lapse of time. This statement is:
subject: Commercial Law
explanation: These are the standard modes of discharge of a contract.

text: List the essentials of a valid contract under the Indian Contract Act.
subject: Commercial Law
correctAnswer: Offer and acceptance; intention to create legal relation; competent parties; free consent; lawful consideration; lawful object; and it must not be declared void.

text: In the absence of a special agreement risk normally follows:
subject: Commercial Law
options: Delivery|Title|Payment|The invoice date
explanation: Where property passes the loss by destruction falls on the owner even before delivery.

text: A sale of goods is complete when:
subject: Commercial Law
options: The full price is paid|Property in the goods passes from the seller to the buyer|The goods reach the buyer|The invoice is issued
explanation: Transfer of property is the defining moment of sale.

text: Goods under the Sale of Goods Act include:
subject: Commercial Law
options: Money only|All movable property other than money and actionable claims|Land and buildings|Shares in a company
explanation: The Act covers movables such as stock and growing crops but not money or intangible claims.

text: In a sale on approval the buyer may test the goods and return them if not satisfied. This statement is:
subject: Commercial Law
explanation: Property passes only when the buyer approves or keeps the goods beyond the allowed time.

text: State the conditions implied under the Sale of Goods Act.
subject: Commercial Law
correctAnswer: Seller's title; merchantable quality; fitness for the particular purpose; and correspondence with description.

text: A cheque is a negotiable instrument under:
subject: Commercial Law
options: The Indian Contract Act|The Negotiable Instruments Act|The Sales Tax Act|The Companies Act
explanation: The Negotiable Instruments Act 1881 governs promissory notes; bills of exchange; and cheques.

text: A bill of exchange is a written instruction:
subject: Commercial Law
options: From the drawer to the drawee to pay a certain sum to the order of a person|From the buyer to the seller|From the bank to the customer only|From the government to the citizen
explanation: It involves three parties: the drawer; the drawee; and the payee.

text: A holder in due course must take the instrument:
subject: Commercial Law
options: After maturity only|In good faith and for value before or at maturity|By gift only|From a stranger to the chain
explanation: These conditions give the holder a better title than the transferor.

text: A promissory note is made and signed by the debtor who promises to pay. This statement is:
subject: Commercial Law
explanation: The maker of a note is the principal debtor and only two parties are involved.

text: Distinguish between a promissory note and a bill of exchange.
subject: Commercial Law
correctAnswer: A note is a written promise by the maker to pay and has two parties; a bill is a written order from drawer to drawee and has three parties; a note needs no acceptance.

text: The Consumer Protection Act 2019 replaced the:
subject: Commercial Law
options: Act of 1986|Contract Act of 1872|Sale of Goods Act of 1930|Companies Act of 2013
explanation: The 2019 Act introduced e commerce protection and a three level commission structure.

text: A dissatisfied consumer may approach the:
subject: Commercial Law
options: Supreme Court only|Appropriate Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission|Police station only|A private arbitration tribunal only
explanation: Complaints go to the district; state; or national commission depending on the value of the claim.

text: Deficiency in service means any fault or lack in the quality or standard of service. This statement is:
subject: Commercial Law
explanation: It covers poor quality; delay; and non performance of promised services.

text: The basic consumer rights include the right to safety; information; choice; and redressal. This statement is:
subject: Commercial Law
explanation: The Act also lists the right to be heard and consumer education.

text: List any four rights of a consumer under the Consumer Protection Act.
subject: Commercial Law
correctAnswer: Right to safety; right to be informed; right to choose; right to redressal; right to be heard; and consumer education.

text: The probability of an impossible event is:
subject: Business Mathematics
explanation: An impossible event never occurs so its probability is zero.

text: The sum of the probabilities of all outcomes of a random experiment is:
subject: Business Mathematics
options: 0|1|Greater than 1|Undefined
explanation: All possible outcomes together are certain so their probabilities add to one.

text: The standard deviation is the square root of the:
subject: Business Mathematics
options: Range|Variance|Median|Mode
explanation: It expresses the average spread of data around the mean in the original units.

text: The mean of a grouped frequency distribution can be estimated by the step deviation method. This statement is:
subject: Business Mathematics
explanation: It is a shortcut of the assumed mean method that works on small coded deviations.

text: State Bayes theorem in words.
subject: Business Mathematics
correctAnswer: The posterior probability of a cause given observed evidence equals the prior probability of the cause times the likelihood of the evidence divided by the total probability of the evidence.

text: An index number expresses the:
subject: Business Mathematics
options: Absolute change in a single item|Relative change in a group of related variables|Only a single price|Quantity of goods produced
explanation: It measures percentage change of a group of prices; quantities; or values against a base period.

text: The simple aggregate method of constructing a price index is also called the:
subject: Business Mathematics
options: Geometric method|Arithmetic method|Weighted method|Fisher method
explanation: It divides the aggregate of current prices by the aggregate of base prices and multiplies by 100.

text: Fishers ideal index number is the geometric mean of the:
subject: Business Mathematics
options: Laspeyres and Paasche indices|Base year and current year prices|Quantity index and price index|Two aggregate indices
explanation: It satisfies the time reversal and factor reversal tests.

text: A consumer price index is mainly useful for measuring household inflation. This statement is:
subject: Business Mathematics
explanation: It tracks price changes of a fixed basket of consumer goods and services.

text: State any four uses of index numbers.
subject: Business Mathematics
correctAnswer: Measuring inflation; deflating values into real terms; comparing changes over time and across regions; and guiding economic policy.

text: The four components of a time series are:
subject: Business Mathematics
options: Trend; seasonal; cyclical; and irregular|Mean; median; mode; and range|Debit; credit; balance; and total|Input; output; stock; and flow
explanation: Any observed value is modeled as a combination of these four forces.

text: The long term rising or falling movement in data is called the:
subject: Business Mathematics
options: Seasonal variation|Trend|Irregular variation|Business cycle
explanation: It is the secular movement that shows the general direction of the series.

text: Seasonal variation is a change within a year that repeats regularly. This statement is:
subject: Business Mathematics
explanation: Examples are holiday shopping peaks and monsoon demand patterns.

text: The moving average method is used to estimate the:
subject: Business Mathematics
options: Trend|Mode|Irregular variation only|Random error only
explanation: Averaging over a window smooths seasonal and irregular fluctuations to reveal the trend.

text: Explain the concept of the business cycle.
subject: Business Mathematics
correctAnswer: It is the recurring but irregular rise and fall of economic activity around the trend with the phases of prosperity; recession; depression; and recovery.

text: In a linear programming problem the objective is to:
subject: Business Mathematics
options: Maximize or minimize a linear function subject to linear constraints|Solve a quadratic equation|Compute a determinant|Balance the books of account
explanation: Both the objective function and the constraints must be linear.

text: The set of all feasible solutions of a linear programming problem is called the:
subject: Business Mathematics
options: Objective region|Feasible region|Shadow region|Dual region
explanation: It is the common area satisfying every constraint including non negativity.

text: The simplex method moves from one:
subject: Business Mathematics
options: Random point to another random point|Corner point to an adjacent better corner point|Center to the edge of the graph|Row to the next column
explanation: An optimum of a linear program always lies at a vertex of the feasible region.

text: Slack variables are added to less than or equal to constraints to convert them into equations. This statement is:
subject: Business Mathematics
explanation: They represent the unused portion of a scarce resource.

text: State the steps of the graphical method for a two variable linear programming problem.
subject: Business Mathematics
correctAnswer: Plot each constraint line; shade the feasible region; evaluate the objective function at every corner point; and choose the corner that gives the best value.

text: According to the law of demand a rise in price causes the quantity demanded to fall. This statement is:
subject: Economics
explanation: The inverse relation holds when other determinants remain unchanged (ceteris paribus).

text: A shift of the demand curve (not a movement along it) is caused by:
subject: Economics
options: A change in the own price of the good|A change in consumer income|A change in the quantity demanded|A change in the price alone
explanation: Income; tastes; prices of related goods; expectations; and the number of buyers shift the curve.

text: When demand rises and supply stays the same the equilibrium price:
subject: Economics
options: Falls|Rises|Stays the same|Becomes zero
explanation: The demand curve shifts right and the intersection moves up along the supply curve.

text: Perfectly elastic demand has a price elasticity of:
subject: Economics
options: 0|1|Infinity|-1
explanation: Any rise in price makes quantity demanded drop to zero.

text: Distinguish between a movement along the demand curve and a shift of the demand curve.
subject: Economics
correctAnswer: A movement along the curve is caused only by a change in the own price; a shift is caused by changes in income; tastes; prices of related goods; expectations; or the number of buyers.

text: The income method of computing national income adds up:
subject: Economics
options: The factor incomes of all producers|Final consumer spending|Exports only|Government debt
explanation: Wages; rent; interest; and profit are summed to get factor income at factor cost.

text: GNP at market prices equals GDP at factor cost plus net factor income from abroad plus:
subject: Economics
options: Indirect taxes minus subsidies|Subsidies minus indirect taxes|Depreciation|Interest on debt
explanation: Statistical adjustments convert factor cost into market prices.

text: Per capita income is national income divided by the population. This statement is:
subject: Economics
explanation: It is used to compare the average income and living standard across countries.

text: The output method computes national income as the sum of value added at each stage of production. This statement is:
subject: Economics
explanation: Adding value added avoids double counting of intermediate goods.

text: List three problems in the measurement of national income.
subject: Economics
correctAnswer: Double counting; non monetary transactions such as home work; and the underground economy of unrecorded activity.

text: The functions of money include:
subject: Economics
options: Medium of exchange; store of value; and unit of account|Only lending|Only payment of taxes|Only savings
explanation: These three are the classic functions recognized in monetary theory.

text: The central bank of India is the:
subject: Economics
options: State Bank of India|Reserve Bank of India|National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development|Union Bank of India
explanation: The RBI acts as banker to the government and to commercial banks.

text: The cash reserve ratio is the fraction of deposits that banks must keep with the RBI as cash. This statement is:
subject: Economics
explanation: Raising the CRR reduces the money banks can lend and tightens liquidity.

text: An increase in the repo rate usually:
subject: Economics
options: Increases the money supply|Reduces the money supply and helps curb inflation|Raises inflation directly|Increases the cash reserve ratio automatically
explanation: Borrowing becomes costlier so credit growth slows and demand pressure eases.

text: Explain the credit creation function of commercial banks.
subject: Economics
correctAnswer: Banks lend out a portion of deposits; when the loan amount is redeposited it is lent again; the process multiplies the initial deposit by the money multiplier which equals one divided by the cash reserve ratio.

text: A country has a comparative advantage when it can produce a good at a:
subject: Economics
options: Higher absolute cost|Lower opportunity cost|Zero cost|Equal cost to others
explanation: Gains from trade arise from differences in opportunity costs not absolute costs.

text: The main advantage of free trade is:
subject: Economics
options: Protection of infant industries|Efficient allocation of resources and higher consumer welfare|Higher tariffs on imports|Reduced competition
explanation: Resources move to their most productive use and consumers get variety at lower prices.

text: The balance of payments is in equilibrium when the current account plus the capital account equals zero. This statement is:
subject: Economics
explanation: A deficit in one account is financed by a surplus in the other.

text: A depreciation of the rupee makes:
subject: Economics
options: Indian exports cheaper for foreign buyers|Imports cheaper for Indians|Both exports and imports cheaper|International trade impossible
explanation: Foreign buyers need fewer of their own currency units for the same rupee price.

text: Distinguish between free trade and protectionism.
subject: Economics
correctAnswer: Free trade removes barriers such as tariffs and quotas so goods move freely; protectionism keeps those barriers to shield domestic industries at the cost of efficiency and higher consumer prices.

text: The Preamble declares India to be a:
subject: Political Science
options: Sovereign socialist secular democratic republic|Theocracy|Monarchy|Federation of provinces only
explanation: The Preamble is the key to the constitution's philosophy and objectives.

text: The words socialist and secular were inserted into the Preamble by the:
subject: Political Science
options: 42nd Amendment|44th Amendment|1st Amendment|86th Amendment
explanation: The 42nd Amendment of 1976 adopted the famous Kiriti mantra language.

text: Articles 12 to 35 of the Constitution deal with:
subject: Political Science
options: Fundamental Rights|Fundamental Duties|Directive Principles of State Policy|Emergency powers
explanation: Part III of the Constitution contains the fundamental rights.

text: The right to equality before law is guaranteed by Article:
subject: Political Science
explanation: Article 14 guarantees equality before law and equal protection of the laws.

text: List any four fundamental freedoms guaranteed by Article 19.
subject: Political Science
correctAnswer: Freedom of speech and expression; to assemble peacefully; to form associations; to move freely; to reside and settle anywhere; and to practice any profession.

text: The Parliament of India consists of:
subject: Political Science
options: The Lok Sabha and the Rajya Sabha|The Lok Sabha and the President|The Rajya Sabha and the Governor|The President and the Supreme Court
explanation: India follows a bicameral legislature with the President as its head.

text: The maximum strength of the Lok Sabha under the Constitution is:
subject: Political Science
explanation: Article 81 fixes the ceiling at 552 members (530 elected and 20 nominated).

text: A money bill can be introduced only in the:
subject: Political Science
options: Rajya Sabha|Lok Sabha|Either house at any time|President's council
explanation: Only the lower house can introduce it and the President's recommendation is needed.

text: The Speaker of the Lok Sabha is elected by the members of the Lok Sabha. This statement is:
subject: Political Science
explanation: The members of the house elect their own Speaker by majority vote.

text: State any three powers of the Rajya Sabha in relation to money bills.
subject: Political Science
correctAnswer: It may recommend changes to a money bill; it can hold the bill for at most six days; and it cannot reject the bill.

text: The Supreme Court of India is located in:
subject: Political Science
options: Bhopal|New Delhi|Chennai|Kolkata
explanation: It was established in 1950 as the apex court of the land.

text: The basic structure doctrine was upheld in the:
subject: Political Science
options: Kesavananda Bharati case|Shankari Prasad case|Golaknath case|Menaka case
explanation: The 1973 judgment held that Parliament cannot alter the basic structure of the Constitution.

text: Judicial review is the power of the courts to:
subject: Political Science
options: Appoint judges|Examine the validity of laws against the Constitution|Audit government expenditure|Dissolve Parliament
explanation: Laws that violate the Constitution can be struck down as unconstitutional.

text: The original jurisdiction of the Supreme Court extends to disputes between the Government of India and a state or between states. This statement is:
subject: Political Science
explanation: Such disputes are directly heard by the Supreme Court under Article 131.

text: Explain the collegium system for judicial appointments.
subject: Political Science
correctAnswer: A collegium of the Chief Justice of India and the four senior most judges recommends appointments and transfers to the higher judiciary and the government acts on the recommendation.

text: The 73rd Constitutional Amendment of 1992 gave constitutional status to:
subject: Political Science
options: Urban local bodies|Panchayats|Cooperative societies|Municipal corporations
explanation: It added the eleventh schedule covering panchayat functions.

text: The 74th Constitutional Amendment deals with:
subject: Political Science
options: Municipal and urban local bodies|Village panchayats|The higher judiciary|Centre state finance
explanation: It came into force in 1993 and strengthened urban local government.

text: The Gram Sabha consists of all persons registered in the electoral roll of the village. This statement is:
subject: Political Science
explanation: It is the basic unit of direct self governance at the village level.

text: The District Planning Committee prepares the plan for the district as a whole. This statement is:
subject: Political Science
explanation: It consolidates the plans of the panchayats and municipal bodies into a district plan.

text: State the main objectives of the Panchayati Raj system.
subject: Political Science
correctAnswer: To democratize governance at the village level; to decentralize development planning; and to give citizens a direct role in deciding local priorities.

text: The Indus Valley Civilization was first excavated at:
subject: History
options: Harappa in 1921|Mohenjo-daro in 1922|Lothal in 1955|Dholavira in 1990
explanation: Dayaram Sahni's excavations at Harappa opened the study of the civilization.

text: The Rig Veda is the:
subject: History
options: Oldest Veda; a collection of hymns to gods|Latest of the four Vedas|Book of law|Collection of dramas
explanation: It contains 1028 hymns in ten mandalas and is the earliest Vedic text.

text: The Harappan port town with a dockyard is:
subject: History
options: Kalibangan|Lothal|Rakhigarhi|Banawali
explanation: The Lothal dockyard shows that the civilization had organized maritime trade.

text: The Vedic society saw the gradual development of the varna based social structure. This statement is:
subject: History
explanation: The later Vedic texts describe the four varnas of brahmana; kshatriya; vaishya; and shudra.

text: List any four features of the Indus Valley Civilization.
subject: History
correctAnswer: Planned brick towns with grid streets; covered drainage; the great bath at Mohenjo-daro; a standardized system of weights; and an undeciphered script.

text: The first ruler of the slave dynasty of the Delhi Sultanate was:
subject: History
options: Iltutmish|Qutb-ud-din Aibek|Alauddin Khalji|Firoz Shah Tughlaq
explanation: He founded the dynasty after the Ghurid conquest of northern India.

text: The Taj Mahal was built by:
subject: History
options: Akbar|Shah Jahan|Aurangzeb|Humayun
explanation: It was built in memory of Mumtaz Mahal and completed around 1653.

text: The first battle of Panipat in 1526 was fought between:
subject: History
options: Babur and Ibrahim Lodi|Akbar and the Afghans|The Marathas and the English|Tipu Sultan and the British
explanation: Babur's use of gunpowder weapons and the tulughma tactic decided the battle.

text: Akbar's Din-i Ilahi was a syncretic faith he promoted to unite different religious groups. This statement is:
subject: History
explanation: It blended elements of Hinduism and Islam and was close to a court philosophy rather than a mass religion.

text: State the main features of Mughal administration under Akbar.
subject: History
correctAnswer: The mansabdari system of ranks; provinces governed by subahdars; a policy of religious tolerance; and a regular revenue system based on land measurement.

text: The Jallianwala Bagh massacre took place at:
subject: History
options: Delhi in 1912|Amritsar in 1919|Mumbai in 1925|Kolkata in 1930
explanation: General Dyer's orders to fire on a peaceful gathering turned public opinion against the Raj.

text: The Dandi March of 1930 was part of:
subject: History
options: The Quit India Movement|The salt satyagraha against the salt tax|The Non Cooperation Movement|The Khilafat Movement
explanation: Breaking the salt law at Dandi on 6 April 1930 gave mass shape to civil disobedience.

text: The Quit India Resolution was passed by the Congress in:
subject: History
explanation: The resolution called for an orderly transfer of power and mass non cooperation.

text: The Indian National Congress was founded in 1885 with A. O. Hume as its key founder. This statement is:
subject: History
explanation: The first session at Bombay in 1885 was presided by W. C. Bonnerjee.

text: Explain the main demands of the Non Cooperation Movement of 1920.
subject: History
correctAnswer: Boycott of British institutions such as schools; courts; and titles; promotion of swadeshi goods and khadi; and support for the Khilafat issue.

text: The First World War began in the year:
subject: History
explanation: The assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand at Sarajevo was the immediate trigger.

text: The United Nations was established in the year:
subject: History
explanation: The Charter was signed at San Francisco in June 1945 to replace the League of Nations.

text: The Cold War was the long standoff between:
subject: History
options: The USA and the Soviet Union|Britain and France|Japan and China|Germany and Italy
explanation: It was an ideological and military rivalry that never became a direct war between the two powers.

text: The fall of the Berlin Wall in 1989 symbolized the beginning of the end of the Cold War era. This statement is:
subject: History
explanation: German reunification followed in 1990 and the Soviet Union dissolved in 1991.

text: State any three causes of the First World War.
subject: History
correctAnswer: Militarism; the alliance system; imperialist rivalry for colonies; and the assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand as the immediate trigger.

text: Culture in sociology refers to:
subject: Sociology
options: Only art and music|The shared patterns of values; beliefs; and practices of a group|Only elite customs|The climate of a region
explanation: Culture is the symbolic system that guides how members of a society think and act.

text: Socialization is the process by which a person learns and internalizes the norms of society. This statement is:
subject: Sociology
explanation: It begins in the family and continues through school; peers; and media.

text: A social institution is best defined as:
subject: Sociology
options: A building|An organized pattern of norms that meets basic social needs|A commercial shop|A government office only
explanation: Family; education; religion; and the economy are classic examples.

text: Emile Durkheim called the shared beliefs and values of a society the:
subject: Sociology
options: Collective consciousness|Social contract|Division of labour|Anomie
explanation: His concept explains how society binds individuals beyond their private interests.

text: Distinguish between society and culture.
subject: Sociology
correctAnswer: Society is the group of people and their patterned interactions; culture is the shared symbolic system of values; beliefs; and practices that the group creates and transmits.

text: The primary agent of socialization is the:
subject: Sociology
options: State|Family|Army|Market
explanation: The family is where children first learn language; norms; and roles.

text: The family is called a primary group because its members have direct and intimate face to face interaction. This statement is:
subject: Sociology
explanation: Cooley used the term primary group for small groups with warm personal contact.

text: Marriage systems studied in sociology include:
subject: Sociology
options: Monogamy and polygamy|Monogamy only|Polyandry only|None of these
explanation: Polygamy further includes polygyny (one husband many wives) and polyandry (one wife many husbands).

text: Education as a social institution functions to transmit knowledge and socialize the young. This statement is:
subject: Sociology
explanation: It also sorts people into roles through credentials and skills.

text: List the main functions of the family.
subject: Sociology
correctAnswer: Reproduction and replacement of members; socialization of children; economic cooperation; emotional support; and regulation of sexual behaviour.

text: The caste system in India is based primarily on:
subject: Sociology
options: Income|Birth|Education|Choice of occupation
explanation: Caste is a closed group assigned at birth with rules on occupation; marriage; and contact.

text: The concept of sanskritisation was coined by:
subject: Sociology
options: M. N. Srinivas|G. S. Ghurye|Louis Dumont|Andre Beteille
explanation: It describes lower castes adopting the customs of higher castes to raise their status.

text: Social mobility refers to the movement of people between social strata. This statement is:
subject: Sociology
explanation: It can be vertical (up or down) or horizontal (across groups at the same level).

text: The jajmani system refers to hereditary patron client relations between caste groups. This statement is:
subject: Sociology
explanation: Artisans received a share of produce and services in return for their work.

text: Distinguish between caste and class.
subject: Sociology
correctAnswer: Caste is a closed; birth ascribed hierarchy with ritual rules and endogamy; class is relatively open; based on wealth and achievement; and allows social mobility.

text: Modernization in Indian society includes:
subject: Sociology
options: Only urbanization|Changes in economy; education; law; and values toward industrial and urban forms|Only new technology|Only new clothing
explanation: It is a broad transformation of social institutions and attitudes.

text: The green revolution in India transformed:
subject: Sociology
options: Agriculture|The judiciary|The army|Theatre
explanation: High yielding seeds; irrigation; and fertilizers raised grain output from the 1960s onward.

text: A social movement is organized collective effort to promote or resist social change. This statement is:
subject: Sociology
explanation: Examples are the independence movement; the women's movement; and environmental movements.

text: Globalization affects society mainly through faster flows of goods; capital; people; and ideas. This statement is:
subject: Sociology
explanation: It also reshapes local cultures and labour markets.

text: State any three factors of social change in India.
subject: Sociology
correctAnswer: Education; industrialization; urbanization; legal reforms such as personal law changes; and globalization.

text: Psychology is the scientific study of:
subject: Psychology
options: Only the soul|Behaviour and mental processes|Only dreams|Only the anatomy of the brain
explanation: It uses observation; experiment; and measurement to understand mind and behaviour.

text: The structuralist school that analyzed conscious experience was founded by:
subject: Psychology
options: William James|Wilhelm Wundt|Ivan Pavlov|B. F. Skinner
explanation: Wundt set up the first psychology laboratory at Leipzig in 1879.

text: The functionalist school emphasized the functions of behaviour and consciousness. This statement is:
subject: Psychology
explanation: Led by William James it asked what mental processes do for the organism.

text: The idea of tabula rasa (mind as a blank slate) is associated with:
subject: Psychology
options: John Locke|Sigmund Freud|Abraham Maslow|Jean Piaget
explanation: Locke argued that experience writes all knowledge onto the empty mind of the child.

text: State three major approaches in modern psychology.
subject: Psychology
correctAnswer: Behaviourism; cognitivism; and psychoanalysis; with the biological and humanistic approaches adding further perspectives.

text: Classical conditioning is associated with:
subject: Psychology
options: B. F. Skinner|Ivan Pavlov|Edward Thorndike|Albert Bandura
explanation: Pavlov's dogs learned to salivate to a bell that predicted food.

text: Operant conditioning modifies behaviour through:
subject: Psychology
options: Reinforcement and punishment|Stimulus pairing only|Observation only|Dream analysis
explanation: Consequences determine how likely a voluntary behaviour is to repeat.

text: The law of effect states that behaviour followed by a satisfying consequence is more likely to recur. This statement is:
subject: Psychology
explanation: Thorndike proposed it from his puzzle box experiments with cats.

text: Short term memory can hold roughly seven plus or minus two items. This statement is:
subject: Psychology
explanation: Miller's finding describes the limited capacity of working memory without rehearsal.

text: Distinguish between classical and operant conditioning.
subject: Psychology
correctAnswer: Classical conditioning pairs stimuli to produce an involuntary response; operant conditioning shapes voluntary behaviour using its consequences such as reinforcement and punishment.

text: The intelligence quotient is computed as mental age divided by chronological age multiplied by 100. This statement is:
subject: Psychology
explanation: This ratio formula was used in early intelligence testing before deviation based scores.

text: Alfred Binet is credited with developing the first practical:
subject: Psychology
options: IQ test for children|Psychotherapy technique|Reflex test|Personality scale
explanation: He and Simon designed school tests to identify pupils needing help.

text: Howard Gardner proposed the theory of:
subject: Psychology
options: A single general intelligence|Multiple intelligences|No measurable intelligence|Only spatial intelligence
explanation: He listed linguistic; logical mathematical; musical; bodily kinesthetic; and other distinct intelligences.

text: The g factor in intelligence theory refers to a general mental ability common to all cognitive tasks. This statement is:
subject: Psychology
explanation: Spearman identified it from the positive correlations among test scores.

text: List the three components of Sternberg's triarchic theory of intelligence.
subject: Psychology

text: A mental disorder can be defined as a syndrome of clinically significant disturbance in cognition; emotion; or behaviour. This statement is:
subject: Psychology
explanation: The definition stresses distress or impairment in addition to the symptoms.

text: A common symptom of anxiety disorders is:
subject: Psychology
options: Excessive worry and tension|High blood pressure only|Fever only|Headache only
explanation: Worry; restlessness; and muscle tension are core features.

text: Cognitive behavioural therapy works by changing maladaptive thoughts and behaviours. This statement is:
subject: Psychology
explanation: It is a structured short term approach with strong evidence for depression and anxiety.

text: Stress is the body's response to any demand that upsets its balance. This statement is:
subject: Psychology
explanation: The demand is called a stressor and the response mobilizes the body to cope.

text: List three signs that a person may need professional mental health support.
subject: Psychology
correctAnswer: Persistent sadness or loss of interest; major changes in sleep or appetite; and social withdrawal or impaired daily functioning.

text: The limit of (x squared - 1) / (x - 1) as x approaches 1 is:
subject: Mathematics
options: 0|2|1|Does not exist
explanation: Factor the numerator as (x-1)(x+1); the quotient becomes x+1 which tends to 2.

text: A function f is continuous at x = a if the limit of f(x) as x approaches a equals f(a). This statement is:
subject: Mathematics
explanation: All three conditions: f(a) exists; the limit exists; and the two are equal.

text: The limit of (sin x) / x as x approaches 0 is:
subject: Mathematics
options: 0|1|Infinity|2
explanation: This standard limit is proved geometrically using the squeeze theorem.

text: The intermediate value theorem requires the function to be:
subject: Mathematics
options: Continuous on a closed interval|Differentiable|Increasing|Periodic
explanation: A continuous function takes every value between its endpoint values.

text: State the definition of continuity of a function at a point.
subject: Mathematics
correctAnswer: The function is continuous at a point if the limit as x approaches the point exists and is equal to the value of the function at that point.

text: The derivative of x cubed is:
subject: Mathematics
options: x squared|3 x squared|3 x|x cubed / 3
explanation: Apply the power rule: bring down the exponent and reduce it by one.

text: The derivative of sin x is:
subject: Mathematics
options: cos x|-cos x|-sin x|tan x
explanation: The derivative of cos x is -sin x which is the companion result.

text: The chain rule states that the derivative of f(g(x)) equals f prime of g(x) times g prime of x. This statement is:
subject: Mathematics
explanation: Differentiate the outer function keeping the inner intact then multiply by the inner derivative.

text: At a local maximum of a differentiable function the derivative equals zero. This statement is:
subject: Mathematics
explanation: Fermat's theorem: an interior extremum of a differentiable function has a horizontal tangent.

text: State the product rule for differentiation.
subject: Mathematics
correctAnswer: The derivative of the product f g is f prime g plus f g prime.

text: The integral of 2x dx is:
subject: Mathematics
options: x squared + C|2 x squared + C|x + C|2 + C
explanation: Differentiating x squared + C gives back 2x.

text: The integral of 1 / x dx is:
subject: Mathematics
options: x + C|ln x + C|1 / x squared + C|e to the x + C
explanation: The natural logarithm is the antiderivative of the reciprocal function.

text: The fundamental theorem of calculus connects differentiation and integration. This statement is:
subject: Mathematics
explanation: It shows that integration is the inverse of differentiation and gives the evaluation rule for definite integrals.

text: The definite integral of 3x squared from 0 to 1 equals:
subject: Mathematics
explanation: An antiderivative is x cubed; evaluating from 0 to 1 gives 1 - 0.

text: Explain what an indefinite integral means.
subject: Mathematics
correctAnswer: It denotes the family of all antiderivatives of a function; any two members differ by a constant C.

text: The order of a differential equation is the:
subject: Mathematics
options: Degree of the highest derivative|Highest order derivative present|Number of independent variables|Power of x
explanation: An equation with y prime prime is of second order.

text: The general solution of dy/dx = y is:
subject: Mathematics
options: y = C e to the x|y = ln x|y = x squared|y = sin x
explanation: Separate variables: dy/y = dx; integrate to get ln|y| = x + C.

text: An equation of the form dy/dx + P(x) y = Q(x) is a first order linear ordinary differential equation. This statement is:
subject: Mathematics
explanation: It is solved using an integrating factor.

text: The integrating factor for dy/dx + P(x) y = Q(x) is e to the integral of P dx. This statement is:
subject: Mathematics
explanation: Multiplying through makes the left side the derivative of a product.

text: Define the order and degree of a differential equation.
subject: Mathematics
correctAnswer: The order is the highest derivative present; the degree is the power of that highest derivative when the equation is a polynomial in its derivatives.

text: The speed of light in vacuum is approximately:
subject: Physics
options: 3 x 10 to the 6 m/s|3 x 10 to the 8 m/s|3 x 10 to the 10 m/s|3 x 10 to the 4 m/s
explanation: It is denoted by c and is a universal constant in relativity.

text: The splitting of white light into its colours is called:
subject: Physics
options: Reflection|Dispersion|Absorption|Emission
explanation: Different wavelengths bend by different amounts in a prism.

text: Young's double slit experiment demonstrates the:
subject: Physics
options: Particle nature of light|Wave nature of light through interference|Gravitation of light|Charge of light
explanation: The alternating bright and dark fringes come from constructive and destructive interference.

text: The focal length of a plane mirror is infinite. This statement is:
subject: Physics
explanation: Its reflecting surface has no curvature so the focal length is taken as infinity.

text: State Huygens' principle.
subject: Physics
correctAnswer: Every point on a wavefront acts as a source of secondary wavelets and the new wavefront is the envelope of those wavelets.

text: The SI unit of electrical resistance is the:
subject: Physics
options: Volt|Ampere|Ohm|Watt
explanation: One ohm is the resistance that allows one ampere under one volt.

text: Ohm's law holds exactly when the:
subject: Physics
options: Temperature is kept constant|Current is zero|Circuit is open|Voltage is changing rapidly
explanation: V = I R for ohmic conductors at constant temperature.

text: The magnetic force on a moving charge is given by F = q v cross B. This statement is:
subject: Physics
explanation: The force is perpendicular to both the velocity and the field and equals q v B sin theta.

text: The unit of inductance is the:
subject: Physics
options: Henry|Farad|Coulomb|Tesla
explanation: A one henry inductor develops one volt when the current changes at one ampere per second.

text: State Kirchhoff's junction rule.
subject: Physics
correctAnswer: The total current entering a junction equals the total current leaving it; it is a statement of conservation of charge.

text: The photoelectric effect was explained by:
subject: Physics
options: Isaac Newton|Albert Einstein|Niels Bohr alone|James Maxwell
explanation: Einstein showed that light comes in quanta (photons) of energy h f; he won the Nobel Prize for this.

text: The energy of a photon is given by:
subject: Physics
options: E = h f|E = m c squared only|E = m v squared|E = h f / c
explanation: Energy is proportional to the frequency of the radiation.

text: In the Bohr model electrons occupy stationary orbits with quantized angular momentum. This statement is:
subject: Physics
explanation: An electron radiates energy only when it jumps between allowed orbits.

text: The energy released in the fission of uranium 235 comes from the mass defect converted by E = m c squared. This statement is:
subject: Physics
explanation: The products weigh slightly less than the reactants and the lost mass appears as energy.

text: State Heisenberg's uncertainty principle.
subject: Physics
correctAnswer: The product of the uncertainties in position and momentum is at least h over 4 pi; the two cannot be known exactly at the same time.

text: The first law of thermodynamics is a statement of:
subject: Physics
options: Increase of entropy|Conservation of energy|Newton's first law|Ohm's law
explanation: Energy can change form but the total energy of an isolated system is constant.

text: In an isothermal process the:
subject: Physics
options: Temperature is constant|Volume is constant|Pressure is constant|Heat exchange is zero
explanation: For an ideal gas internal energy depends only on temperature so delta U is zero in an isothermal change.

text: The efficiency of a Carnot engine depends only on the temperatures of the source and the sink. This statement is:
subject: Physics
explanation: No real engine can exceed the Carnot efficiency for the same reservoirs.

text: Absolute zero is:
subject: Physics
options: 0 degrees Celsius|0 kelvin (about -273.15 degrees Celsius)|100 kelvin|-100 degrees Celsius
explanation: It is the lower limit of the thermodynamic temperature scale.

text: State the second law of thermodynamics in the Clausius form.
subject: Physics
correctAnswer: Heat cannot of itself pass from a colder body to a hotter body; external work is required for refrigeration.

text: The bond formed by the sharing of electron pairs is the:
subject: Chemistry
options: Ionic bond|Covalent bond|Metallic bond|Hydrogen bond
explanation: Atoms share pairs to complete their valence shells.

text: The shape of the methane molecule is:
subject: Chemistry
options: Linear|Tetrahedral|Trigonal planar|Octahedral
explanation: Four equivalent C-H bonds point to the corners of a tetrahedron with 109.5 degree angles.

text: The VSEPR theory predicts molecular shape from the:
subject: Chemistry
options: Repulsion of electron pairs around the central atom|Mass of the central atom|Charge of the nucleus only|Colour of the compound
explanation: Electron pairs arrange themselves as far apart as possible.

text: Among H2O; H2S; HCl; and CH4 the strongest hydrogen bonding is shown by water. This statement is:
subject: Chemistry
explanation: Oxygen is small and highly electronegative so O-H-O hydrogen bonds are strong.

text: Distinguish between an ionic bond and a covalent bond.
subject: Chemistry
correctAnswer: An ionic bond involves transfer of electrons between metal and non metal with electrostatic attraction and high melting points; a covalent bond involves sharing of electron pairs usually between non metals with lower melting points.

text: Gibbs free energy is defined as:
subject: Chemistry
options: G = H - T S|G = H + T S|G = U + P V only|G = T S - H
explanation: It combines enthalpy and entropy into one quantity for spontaneity at constant T and P.

text: A reaction is spontaneous when delta G is:
subject: Chemistry
options: Positive|Negative|Zero|Infinite
explanation: Delta G = 0 means the system is at equilibrium.

text: The entropy of a system increases when its disorder increases. This statement is:
subject: Chemistry
explanation: Gases have higher entropy than liquids which have higher entropy than solids.

text: The enthalpy change of a reaction depends only on the initial and final states. This statement is:
subject: Chemistry
explanation: Enthalpy is a state function; this is the basis of Hess's law.

text: State the first law of thermodynamics with its equation.
subject: Chemistry
correctAnswer: Energy of the universe is constant; for a system the change in internal energy equals heat added plus work done: delta U = q + w.

text: The device that converts chemical energy into electrical energy is:
subject: Chemistry
options: An electrolytic cell|A galvanic (voltaic) cell|A transformer|A capacitor
explanation: A spontaneous redox reaction drives the current in a galvanic cell.

text: The standard hydrogen electrode is assigned a potential of:
subject: Chemistry
explanation: All standard electrode potentials are measured relative to it.

text: The Nernst equation is used to calculate the cell potential under non standard conditions. This statement is:
subject: Chemistry
explanation: It relates potential to the activities (concentrations) of the reacting species.

text: Corrosion of iron is essentially an electrochemical oxidation process. This statement is:
subject: Chemistry
explanation: Iron acts as an anode and loses electrons in the presence of moisture and oxygen.

text: State Faraday's first law of electrolysis.
subject: Chemistry
correctAnswer: The mass of a substance deposited or liberated at an electrode is proportional to the quantity of electricity that passes through the electrolyte: m = Z I t.

text: The central metal ion in the complex [Co(NH3)6]Cl3 is:
subject: Chemistry
options: Chlorine|Cobalt|Ammonia|Nitrogen
explanation: Six ammonia ligands are coordinated to the cobalt inside the brackets.

text: The coordination number of the complex ion [Fe(CN)6] 3- is:
subject: Chemistry
explanation: It equals the number of donor atoms bonded to the central metal; here six cyanide carbons.

text: Ammonia acts as a monodentate ligand. This statement is:
subject: Chemistry
explanation: It donates a single lone pair from the nitrogen atom.

text: The complex [Co(NH3)6]Cl3 dissociates in solution into one complex cation and three chloride ions. This statement is:
subject: Chemistry
explanation: The ions inside the coordination sphere do not ionize; the counter ions do.

text: Define a ligand and a coordination entity.
subject: Chemistry
correctAnswer: A ligand is an ion or molecule that donates a lone pair of electrons to a metal; the coordination entity is the central metal with its ligands enclosed in brackets.

text: A variable in programming is:
subject: Computer Science
options: A named storage location whose value can change|A constant only|A function|A comment
explanation: Its value can be read and reassigned during execution.

text: In Python which of the following is an immutable data type:
subject: Computer Science
options: list|tuple|dict|set
explanation: Once created a tuple's elements cannot be changed.

text: The time complexity of binary search on a sorted array of n elements is:
subject: Computer Science
options: O(n)|O(log n)|O(n squared)|O(1)
explanation: The search space is halved at every step.

text: An infinite loop occurs when the loop condition never becomes false. This statement is:
subject: Computer Science
explanation: A missing or wrong update of the loop variable is the most common cause.

text: Distinguish between a compiler and an interpreter.
subject: Computer Science
correctAnswer: A compiler translates the whole source program into machine code before execution; an interpreter executes the source line by line at run time.

text: A stack follows the:
subject: Computer Science
options: FIFO principle|LIFO principle|Random access principle|Priority principle
explanation: The last element pushed is the first one popped.

text: A queue follows the FIFO principle. This statement is:
subject: Computer Science
explanation: The first element enqueued is the first one dequeued; it models waiting lines.

text: In a binary search tree the left child of a node holds keys:
subject: Computer Science
options: Larger than the node|Smaller than the node|Equal to the node|Always null
explanation: This ordering makes search traverse one side at a time.

text: The average time complexity of a hash table lookup with a good hash function is O(1). This statement is:
subject: Computer Science
explanation: Collisions degrade the worst case but the average stays constant for a good load factor.

text: State three applications of a stack.
subject: Computer Science
correctAnswer: Managing function calls (the call stack); evaluating arithmetic expressions; and matching brackets in code.

text: In a relational database a table is a:
subject: Computer Science
options: File|Relation|Class|Pointer
explanation: Rows are tuples and columns are attributes of the relation.

text: The SQL command used to retrieve data is:
subject: Computer Science
options: INSERT|SELECT|UPDATE|DELETE
explanation: SELECT specifies which columns and which rows to return.

text: The primary key of a table must be unique and not null. This statement is:
subject: Computer Science
explanation: It uniquely identifies every row of the table.

text: Normalization is used to reduce redundancy and update anomalies. This statement is:
subject: Computer Science
explanation: Each form of normal form removes a specific kind of dependency problem.

text: Explain what a foreign key is.
subject: Computer Science
correctAnswer: A foreign key is a column or set of columns in one table that references the primary key of another table; it enforces the relationship between the two tables.

text: An operating system manages:
subject: Computer Science
options: Only the CPU|The CPU; memory; files; and devices|Only the display|Only the keyboard
explanation: It acts as the resource manager between applications and hardware.

text: The process of switching the CPU between running processes is called:
subject: Computer Science
options: Context switching|Printing|Compiling|Booting
explanation: The saved state of one process is stored and the state of the next is restored.

text: The four Coffman conditions for deadlock are mutual exclusion; hold and wait; no preemption; and circular wait. This statement is:
subject: Computer Science
explanation: All four must hold simultaneously for deadlock to occur; removing any one prevents it.

text: Virtual memory allows processes to use disk space as an extension of RAM. This statement is:
subject: Computer Science
explanation: The page table maps virtual pages to physical frames and pages out rarely used pages.

text: List the four Coffman conditions required for deadlock.
subject: Computer Science
correctAnswer: Mutual exclusion; hold and wait; no preemption; and circular wait.
